name: Elavon online payments

evidence.gateway: F02: payment gateway and acquiring; the merchant remains the seller
evidence.billing: F15: UK back office sets recurring plans with frequency, intro pricing and end dates
evidence.links: F16: UK payment links, reusable or single-use, shared by email, SMS or social URL

line: Online acquiring and checkout for UK, European and North American merchants.

cells.countries: UK, Ireland, Germany and other local markets
cells.payout: UK next day or within 48 hours by plan

fee.math: The US card price is set by a sales quote, not a public rate.
The UK rate starts at 0.99% per transaction. The final rate depends on card turnover, meaning total card sales.
Germany has its own local merchant site, but no German card price is published.
It isn't published whether Indian sellers can sign up, and no India card price is published.
